enumDescriptions: tectonic: self-contained engine that downloads packages on demand
latexmk -pdf: runs pdflatex/bibtex as often as needed (TeX Live, MiKTeX)
orcaInp.studio.latexEngine.description: LaTeX engine the Report tab compiles with.

orcaInp.studio.latexPath.description: Full path of the LaTeX engine executable; empty = the engine name on PATH.

orcaInp.studio.compileTimeoutSec.description: Seconds after which a LaTeX compilation is stopped.

orcaInp.studio.reportFile.description: The .tex the Report tab opens (relative to the first workspace folder). Empty = ask, then remember the last one opened.

orcaInp.studio.figureGlobs.description: Images in the workspace the Report tab offers to import into the report's figures folder.

notes: Report tab (src/studio/tabs/report, webview/src/tabs/report). Build output goes to <storageDir>/report-build/<name>-<hash>/, backups of every save to <storageDir>/report-backups. 'Send to report' from any tab arrives as the incomingFigure event (studio.sendToReport); the figure files are written next to the .tex in figures/. onNavigate accepts { texFile: <path> }. A command such as 'Orbital: Edit Report' (orcaInp.openStudio with tab 'report' and { texFile }) on .tex files in the explorer would be a natural follow-up (explorer/context, when resourceExtname == .tex).
